description: Defines psychoacoustic configuration structures and functions for audio encoding, including long and short frame configurations, and functions to initialize configurations and get sample rate index.

methods.name: GetSRIndex
methods.description: Returns the sample rate index for a given sample rate.

methods.name: InitPsyConfigurationLong
methods.description: Initializes psychoacoustic configuration for long frames based on bitrate, sample rate, and bandwidth.

methods.name: InitPsyConfigurationShort
methods.description: Initializes psychoacoustic configuration for short frames based on bitrate, sample rate, and bandwidth.
